verdict.rationale: Pika documents a Talking Head Video app for making a virtual spokesperson. You add a script and choose a presenter, or use your own image and audio, which covers both stock and custom presenter-led video without a camera. AI lip sync also animates an uploaded image to speech. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, clarity on whether a custom image can be driven by a pasted script (the custom path pairs it with your own audio), and detail on the stock presenter library.

support.subject: As a marketer, I can paste a script and get a presenter-led video with a stock or custom avatar, no camera or studio

citations.quote: Add a script and choose a presenter, or use your own image and audio for explainers, demos and video messages.
Talking Head Video: Make a virtual spokesperson
Upload an image and speech, music or a voice recording to create an animated performance with AI lip sync.
